use archived-evidence with a stable evidence reference for the retained prototype

use prototype observations as production acceptance evidence

cases.input: A migration prototype contains shortcuts and cannot be safely retained. Delete the prototype code, but preserve enough verified observations and decision evidence to reconstruct why the approach was rejected later.
requiredBehaviors: select deleted as the single disposal state
preserve learning and decision evidence after experimental code deletion
record that only evidence remains rather than inventing a retained artifact reference
forbiddenBehaviors: delete the experiment without preserving its learning evidence
claim a stable prototype artifact still exists after deletion
